The '''RH-1 missile launcher''' was a single-use missile launcher used to destroy enemy barricades.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
If players choose the infantry route in the Trooper class mission "The Battle of Corellia" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', they use an RH-1 launcher to destroy a barricade.
